## Services
- Product design (UX + UI in Figma, developer-ready): $3,000-$7,000, 4-8 weeks. https://anowarhdesign.com/services/product-design
- Webflow development (editor-proof CMS, migration, QA): $2,500-$6,000, 4-6 weeks. https://anowarhdesign.com/services/webflow-development
- Framer development (landing pages, launch sites, motion): from $900, 1-2 weeks. https://anowarhdesign.com/services/framer-development
- AI product builds (finishing Lovable / v0 / Claude Code prototypes): $1,500-$4,000, 2-5 weeks. https://anowarhdesign.com/services/ai-product-builds
